title: Exchange fluid viscosity forces
scope: Implement viscosity exchange between compatible fluid populations.
acceptance: Dissipation and momentum satisfy the profile across timestep/mass-ratio sweeps.
Isolated and coupled limits have analytic or invariant tests.
evidence: CPU Slang split-versus-combined fixture matches viscosity acceleration and one-step position and velocity.
Analytic isolated and coupled limits pass; momentum conservation and energy dissipation pass at timesteps 0.001, 0.01 and 0.05 across 1:1, 1:2 and 1:4 population-mass ratios.
All 49 foundation tests pass or report their existing capability skips; Slang CPU, CUDA and Vulkan driver targets build.
